The '''Infantry Support Platform (ISP)''', also known as the '''swamp speeder''', was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|speeder]] first deployed by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] for swamp combat during the late [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:ISP_EaW.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-era ISP.]]
It had a semi-circular base protected by a red-and-white armored shell. Mounted on the rear was a large turbofan, which, working with the speeder's [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] drive, propelled the craft through swamps. The 100 kph thrust-fan provided both forward propulsion and a precise braking airblast when reversed.

It was crewed by two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that sat on either side of the engine, operating controls or firing the vehicle's two forward-mounted [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]]. The cannons are able to cause damage to light-armored targets, and with a precise hit, can rupture heavier targets as well.<ref name="wizards" />

These twin-[[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] were highly effective against infantry forces such as [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] and [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 super battle droids]], and even the larger units such as the [[NR-N99 Persuader-class droid enforcer/Legends|NR-N99 ''Persuader''-class droid enforcers]] and [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|Heavy Missile Platforms]] encountered on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] and [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].

==History==
<div style="float:right">[[File:ISP_KKruhk_TCWCG.jpg|thumb|180px|[[K'Kruhk]] leaps from a moving ISP]]</div>
Introduced by the time of the [[Battle of Queel]],<ref name="Crash Course">''[[The Clone Wars: Crash Course]]''</ref> it was one of many specialized speeders created during the Clone Wars and a heavy variant of the [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]]. A terrain laser scanner was fitted to the speeder's underside, allowing clone troopers to scout the environment for any foes. It was notably used during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] and the [[Battle of Mygeeto]].

Like many other vehicles of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the swamp speeder was used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] by both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces. Additionally, [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and planetary organizations would acquire and utilize some units. These would then be used to conduct raids, protect fortresses, or aid allied factions. The most notable organizations to use them were [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], and the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]].

==Behind the scenes==
Concept artist [[T.J. Frame]] was tasked with developing vehicle designs when he first joined the Episode III Art Department. One of his earliest designs was an extrapolation of a Star Wars-style swamp boat, inspired by the [[Wikipedia:Airboat|fanboats]] used here on Earth.<ref name="DB-swamp speeder">{{DB|vehicle|swampspeeder|swamp speeder}}</ref>
